{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check the 'loyal' segment exists
print("Unique customer_segment values:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check the status values
print("Unique status values:", sales['status'].unique())

# Check revenue column
print("Sample of revenue column:", sales['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_neg1 = sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {len(age_neg1)}")"}
